sources.games: 314 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 56.7%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py juggernaut.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Bloodthorn, Butterfly, Black King Bar.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast; high-rank Juggernauts buy it against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 43% of 30 games against them (13% otherwise), won 62% against 47%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. Against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 14% of 21 games against them (2% otherwise), won 67% against 56% (a thin sample).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 23% (3), magic_wand 82% (4), power_treads 89% (6), pers 92% (10), bfury 93% (13), yasha 98% (17), manta 83% (20), sange 24% (22), butterfly 68% (26), ultimate_scepter 46% (30).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where he wins 85.0%+: 20:00 11500 (66 games, 86.4%), 25:00 18000 (11 games, 90.9%), 30:00 22000 (36 games, 86.1%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. The 25:00 point (18k gold, 11 games) is too thin and is left out: the line is linear from 20 to 30 min.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 314 games: maxed juggernaut_blade_fury > juggernaut_blade_dance > juggernaut_healing_ward 206 (win 56.8%), juggernaut_blade_fury > juggernaut_healing_ward > juggernaut_blade_dance 31 (win 74.2%), juggernaut_blade_dance > juggernaut_healing_ward > juggernaut_blade_fury 25 (win 72.0%); talents 10: -1.0s Bladeform Stack Gain Interval 258/314 (57.4%), -12s Healing Ward Cooldown 56/314 (53.6%); 15: Omnislash Cooldown 221/299 (58.4%), 45 Movement Speed During Blade Fury 78/299 (59.0%); 20: +15% Blade Dance Crit Damage 182/212 (68.7%), Blade Fury DPS 30/212 (60.0%); 25: +40% Blade Dance Lifesteal 58/81 (72.4%), +1s Omnislash Duration 23/81 (43.5%).

suppress.illusions: Battle Fury (93% of his won games, ~13 min) already cleaves the illusions around his target; high-rank Juggernauts never add Maelstrom against illusion heroes.
suppress.magic: Blade Fury makes him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance for 5 s (Valve 7.41f) and the strong dispel at its end removes what landed; against 3+ magic damage heroes his players buy Black King Bar no more often than otherwise.
